title: Instant Claims Reserve Rate — Pocketwire Business Profile Risk Standard
content:
The instant claims reserve percentage on a Pocketwire Business Profile is 8 percent when the profile has both a chargeback dated within the rolling 3 months ending on the handling date and a buyer claim still open, 4 percent when it has exactly one of those two, and nothing when it has neither. A claim is open while the profile's claim openings outnumber its claim closings. A rolling window of a number of months ending on the handling date covers the dates after the same calendar day that many months earlier, up to and including the handling date.

| Chargeback dated in the rolling 3 months | Buyer claim still open | Instant claims reserve percentage |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 8 percent |
| yes | no | 4 percent |
| no | yes | 4 percent |
| no | no | none |

**Reading the records (hypothetical).** A profile with 3 claims opened and 3 closed has no claim open; with 3 opened and 2 closed it has one open. A chargeback dated 2 February counts on a handling date of 1 May (the window covers the dates after 1 February) and does not count on a handling date of 2 May.
